chunks: Ibn Abī ʿUmayr narrated from Abū Ziyād al-Nahdī, from ʿAbdullāh ibn Wahb, from al-Ṣādiq Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad عليه السلام, who said:
It is sufficient as support from Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, for the believer that he sees his enemy acting in disobedience to Allah, the Mighty and Majestic.

key_terms.بِمَعَاصِي ٱللَّهِ: through acts of disobedience against Allah
key_terms.عَدُوَّهُ: his enemy; the one opposed to him
key_terms.نُصْرَةً: support, aid, or victory granted by Allah
key_terms.ٱلْمُؤْمِنِ: the believer; the one characterized by iman

ai.seo_question: How is seeing an enemy commit sins considered help from Allah for a believer?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that one form of divine support for the believer is seeing his enemy fall into disobedience to Allah, since sin itself is a mark of loss and disgrace. It frames true victory in moral and spiritual terms, not merely worldly triumph.
